title: "Destined Battle"
next_chapter_hook: "Just as Ling Yuan's assault was about to completely crush Chen Ji's resolve, a sinister black energy surged from his palm—that was the aura of an ancient forbidden technique. Mo Xiansheng in the spectator seats abruptly changed expression, his fragmented soul trembling violently."

text.content: "Ling Yuan stood with hands clasped behind his back at the center of the Arena Platform, his aura deep as an abyss and vast as the sea. When his turbid old eyes swept over Chen Ji, they were filled with undisguised contempt, as if looking at an ant about to be crushed. The formation runes around the Arena Platform hummed incessantly—they were set to prevent the battle's aftermath from harming spectators, yet now showed signs of being unable to withstand the pressure of two powerhouses."

"Chen Ji stood ten zhang away, his expression平静得近乎麻木. The worn-out Servant Disciple robe on him fluttered violently beneath the fierce spiritual pressure, yet he never retreated a single step. Only in the depths of those lowered eyes did a barely perceptible gleam flash—he was calculating, deducing, searching for that single thread of life among countless possibilities."

dialogue.content: "What, scared?" Ling Yuan sneered, sweeping his sleeve to send out a jade ruler glowing verdant green, hovering mid-air. The moment the spiritual weapon appeared, the world suddenly darkened. Though only a mid-grade spiritual weapon, it radiated a chilling pressure. "I originally wanted to keep you until the finals to show the world what a joke the Tianji Record is. Since you've jumped out to seek death yourself, I'll grant your wish."

text.content: "On the Arena Platform, spiritual pressure pressed down like mountains. Ling Yuan merely released his aura, yet cracks already spread across the blue stone floor beneath Chen Ji's feet like a spider's web. Foundation Building Late Stage versus Qi Refining Peak—a full two minor realms apart, nearly an insurmountable chasm in the cultivation world. Sighs rose and fell from the spectator seats; no one favored this废物 servant."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji slowly raised his head, the corner of his mouth curving into a faint arc. He made no reply to Ling Yuan's provocation, only producing a rust-eaten iron sword from his chest—the most common work sword from the Servants' Quarters, not even qualifying as a low-grade spiritual weapon. "The senior is right," his voice terrifyingly calm, "a废物 should死 in a废物's way."

text.content: "Before the words even finished, Chen Ji moved. He did not ride his sword, employed no flashy techniques—only the explosive power of his legs, sending him hurtling toward Ling Yuan like a departing arrow. The rusty sword in his palm swept out a fierce arc, aiming straight for Ling Yuan's throat—the most clumsy attack method, yet also the most unexpected."

"A flash of astonishment crossed Ling Yuan's eyes, then transformed into boundless fury. A Qi Refining stage废物 dared to take the initiative and attack him? Absolute insult! He raised a hand and pointed, a pillar of spiritual light shooting forth, colliding violently with the rusty sword. The massive shockwave sent Chen Ji flying backward, crashing onto the ground ten zhang away, creating a pit three chi deep."

dialogue.content: "Is this all you've got?" Ling Yuan stepped forward, spiritual pressure surged toward Chen Ji like a tide. "I thought the inheritor of the Tianji Record would have some earth-shaking abilities. Turns out just an overestimating fool! Ha ha ha ha!" Laughter echoed throughout the Martial Arena, filled with condescending superiority."

text.content: "However, in the next moment, Ling Yuan's laughter stopped abruptly. Where the dust settled, Chen Ji slowly rose from the deep pit. Covered in blood, clothes torn—utterly wretched—yet his eyes burned even brighter than before. At his chest, a page of yellowed fragment glowed faintly: the first page of the Tianji Record, frantically warning of some lethal danger."

"Chen Ji's heart seized. The Tianji Record's warning came too urgently—this meant Ling Yuan's next strike was no ordinary probe. Three hours... no, one hour later, a killing move sufficient to change the entire battlefield situation would arrive. He must find a flaw before then, or today would truly be his死期."

choice.prompt: "Ling Yuan's momentum had reached its peak. Chen Ji had to make a choice: continue enduring with his mortal body to drain the enemy's patience, or proactively expose a flaw to lure the opponent into revealing weaknesses?"

choices.description: "Trade injuries for injuries, use extreme combat instincts to force Ling Yuan into exposing weaknesses, while preserving trump cards and awaiting the right moment."
choices.risk_hint: "Risk Fatal Strikes Due to Excessive Realm Gap"

text.content: "Chen Ji gnashed his teeth, letting out a low roar. The rusty sword blocked before him, he charged toward Ling Yuan once more. His movements appeared chaotic yet contained a strange rhythm—the optimal attack path the Tianji Record had deduced countless times in an instant. Ling Yuan's brow furrowed; he flicked his fingers repeatedly, pillar after pillar of spiritual light bombarding Chen Ji."

choices.description: "Deliberately create a flaw, letting Ling Yuan think victory is assured. When he lowers his guard, seek the truly lethal weakness."
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan May See Through the Ruse"

text.content: "Chen Ji's form suddenly wavered, staggering—a deliberately crafted flaw. He intentionally exposed his right flank, where the protective spiritual light was thinnest. Ling Yuan took the bait, greed flashing in his eyes as he slapped toward Chen Ji's right ribs."

choices.description: "Prematurely reveal part of the Tianji Record's abilities, using deception to cause Ling Yuan to misjudge the situation, while secretly observing his countermeasures."
choices.visible_reward: "Clearly See All of Ling Yuan's Trump Cards"
choices.risk_hint: "Exposing the Tianji Record May Invite Greater Covetousness"

text.content: "Chen Ji's mind stirred. The Tianji Record Fragment blazed with brilliant golden light. A vague premonition flickered before Ling Yuan's eyes—a false future Chen Ji had long prepared. Ling Yuan's pupils contracted; he instinctively stepped back half a pace, his expression showing gravity for the first time."

"In the instant before their techniques were about to collide, Chen Ji's pupils suddenly constricted. The Tianji Record's warning reached its peak at this moment—he finally saw through Ling Yuan's hidden true killing move. Within that verdant jade ruler was sealed a strand of ancient demonic energy—forbidden power strictly prohibited by the righteous path!"

dialogue.content: "Well done, Tianqing Sect's former Patriarch!" Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned ice-cold. "So Ling Senior's confidence lies not merely in those two minor realms of cultivation, but also in this unspeakable thing. He raised a finger pointing at the hovering jade ruler. Fellow disciples and seniors, why not examine what exactly is sealed within that spiritual weapon!"

text.content: "The words ignited chaos throughout the arena. Ling Yuan's expression instantly turned to the extremes of gloom. He never imagined Chen Ji could see through his hidden move. A torrent of killing intent erupted from within him, enveloping the entire Arena Platform. No more concealing—if his trump card was exposed, he would erase everything with absolute power!"

choice.prompt: "Ling Yuan's killing intent was no longer hidden. Chen Ji had to make his final choice in this desperate situation: expose the matter publicly to force Ling Yuan to retreat, or face that forbidden technique energy head-on?"

choices.description: "Publicly expose evidence of Ling Yuan's forbidden technique use, leverage all the cultivators present as supervisors to force him to stand down. Even if victory isn't possible, make him utterly disgraced."
choices.risk_hint: "Ling Yuan May Desperately Try to Silence Witness on the Spot"

text.content: "Chen Ji swept his gaze across his surroundings, his voice thundering: "Everyone saw it! Tianqing Sect's former Patriarch, a堂堂元婴大能, actually sealed ancient demonic energy within a spiritual weapon—such conduct differs how from the Demonic Path?" Turmoil immediately erupted among the spectator seats; many cultivators' gazes toward Ling Yuan shifted."

choices.description: "Stop holding back. Use the Tianji Record's foresight to dodge the forbidden technique attacks, seeking counter-kill opportunities in the flash of lightning."

text.content: "Ling Yuan spoke no more nonsense. His palm pressed violently onto the jade ruler. A thick black energy poured forth, transforming into a ferocious magic snake that lunged straight for Chen Ji's face. Where the snake passed, even the air hissed from corrosion—absolutely terrifying."

"Chen Ji retreated sharply, feet tracing mysterious movements. The Tianji Record operated frantically within his mind; countless images flashed like a carousel—he saw the snake's trajectory, saw the counter-move three breaths later, saw the fleeting triumph in Ling Yuan's eyes. He saw it all."

"At the instant the magic snake was about to devour him, Chen Ji猛地侧身, barely evading the lethal strike. The snake whistled past his sleeve, corroding a bottomless black hole in the ground behind him. Shouts of alarm rose and fell throughout the spectator seats. No one expected a Qi Refining stage废物 to escape from an Nascent Soul cultivator's forbidden technique attack."

"Ling Yuan's face was as dark as water. He hadn't anticipated Chen Ji possessing such keen insight, able to dodge the magic snake attack at the critical moment. What made him even more wary was that Chen Ji seemed to have known he would use this move all along—could this foresight ability be the power of the Tianji Record?"

"Good! Good! Good!" Ling Yuan uttered three "goods" in succession, killing intent nearly condensing into substance. "Let me see how many times you can dodge!" He formed seals with both hands; the magic snake suddenly split into dozens of small serpents, surrounding Chen Ji from all directions. This time, no matter how Chen Ji dodged, there was no escape."

"In the instant those dozens of magic snakes were about to encircle completely, Chen Ji suddenly smiled. It was an understanding, a relieved, even somewhat mocking smile. He raised his right hand; a pitch-black token slipped from his sleeve—the Holy Sect Young Master's Token of the Demonic Path! Ling Yuan's pupils contracted violently. He finally realized—this废物 was never simple from the start."

"In the deepest part of the spectator seats, Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul suddenly trembled violently. He stared fixedly at the token in Chen Ji's sleeve, an absolutely horrified expression flashing across his turbid eyes. The aura of that token resonated with a forbidden name in the depths of his memory—the true origin of the Tianji Record was far more terrifying than anyone could imagine."

"On the Arena Platform, Chen Ji held the Holy Sect Token, waving it gently. A layer of invisible mist poured forth from the token, instantly enveloping the entire battlefield. That was Ye Qing's protective手段—a Demonic Path Mist, capable of concealing all heavenly secrets. Ling Yuan's magic snakes lost their target at this moment, twisting and hissing frantically within the mist yet never finding Chen Ji's figure."

"Chen Ji's voice resounded within the mist, carrying a hint of mockery: "Ling Senior, you thought you were the only one with unspeakable things?" He walked slowly out of the mist, his form indistinct beneath the cover of black energy. "Today's battle isn't settled yet. We'll see. As he spoke, his gaze quietly swept toward Mo Xiansheng in the spectator seats—there lay his true trump card."

"However, at this moment, a诡异的 smile spread across Ling Yuan's face. "Petty tricks!" He coldly snorted. Another talisman flew from his sleeve—a prohibition talisman emanating ancient aura, its runes unlike anything Chen Ji had ever seen. The talisman emerged; Ling Yuan's surrounding demonic energy surged violently, his momentum breaking through some critical threshold."

"That was the aura of an ancient forbidden technique. Mo Xiansheng's face greatly changed; his fragmented soul trembled violently. He recognized the talisman's origin—it was a prohibition talisman from ancient times used to seal the Tianji Record! Ling Yuan not only knew of the Tianji Record's existence but also knew how to target its weaknesses! Chen Ji's heart seized; the Tianji Record warned frantically at this moment, revealing a harsh truth: this move, he could not dodge."
